text:
alice: Starting a green-fade attempt at 13:00 UTC. Plan: 0%->20%->50% over 10m windows, snapshot not required. Drain sessions on green, run smoke tests at each step. Rollback criteria: p50 latency > 300ms OR error rate > 1%.
ben: Added route config to router: `svc-routing: service-v2-green` and prepared the LB rule. I'll trigger the deploy-bot when ready.
carol: FYI we have the change window 13:00-15:00. oncall-uk is on stand-by.
oncall-uk: standing by. If anything spikes ping here + @alice.
deploy-bot: /deploy start traffic-shift --src=service-v1 --dst=service-v2-green --steps=20,50,100 --wait=600
deploy-bot: Initial health checks passing: 200/200 on /health across green instances.
ben: Kicking first step to 20% now.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift: step 1 -> 20% completed at 13:02 UTC. routed=120 req/s, green=24 req/s.
carol: quick smoke: POST /generate -> 200 OK, p95 210ms. All good so far.
alice: Monitor RPS and backend GPU queue length. If queue depth > 12 for 2 consecutive mins, pause the shift.
ben: small p95 bump to 270ms on a subset of pods (eu-west1). Looks like zone-specific queueing. Tagging route to avoid eu-west1 for next 10m.
oncall-uk: noted. Draining eu-west1 green nodes and rerouting to other zones.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift: step 2 -> 50% completed at 13:12 UTC. routed=300 req/s, green=150 req/s.
carol: Error rate ticked to 0.9% for 2 mins on batch endpoint. Close to threshold but still under.
alice: Hold at 50% while we investigate cause. Can someone check model artifact/quantization mismatch?
ben: Checking model tags. v2-green is running `q8_legacy` while prod v1 is `q4`. Suspect mismatch causing extra CPU work. Rolling a hotfix to use q4-compatible container.
ben: Pushing rollout: container tag fix -> will restart green pods (graceful) (ETA ~90s).
deploy-bot: restart pods initiated on v2-green (rolling): 6 pods restarting, status: in_progress.
deploy-bot: restart pods completed, all pods back to Ready.
carol: After restart p95 back to 220ms and errors down to 0.2%.
alice: Good. Continue to final step after a 5m watch. Keep manual hold if any abnormal metrics.
oncall-uk: watching traces and infra metrics. No new alerts so far.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift: final step -> 100% completed at 13:23 UTC. All traffic now on service-v2-green.
ben: Post-cutover canary logs show a short retry storm at 13:18 caused by a dependent cache timeout; root-cause patched in downstream client.
carol: Running acceptance suite now: auth, generate, batch, embeddings - all passing.
alice: Release note draft: "green-fade 2025-07-05 — deployed service-v2-green with container tag aligned to q4 quantization; avoided eu-west1 transient queueing during shift. Rollback thresholds p50>300ms or err>1%."
ben: Follow-up: schedule a small job to unify quantization tags in CI to avoid future container restarts.
alice: Closing the thread. Nice work team :tada:
